title: Best Facial Serum (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from Consumer Reports, NYTimes, CNET, NYPost, BlueRockLiving, and WilmaSchumann.com. Preference was given to items mentioned by more than one source and to those with clear, source‑based benefits.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a busy professional who needs 24‑hour hydration for normal to dry skin. The serum delivers that with hyaluronic acid and ceramides, keeping the skin barrier strong. Its main catch is that it is not a sunscreen, so it should be paired with sun protection.
